attributes.title: SHM Converge 2027
attributes.summary:
SHM Converge 2027 runs March 30 to April 2, 2027, at Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino in Las Vegas; March 30 is for pre-courses and the main conference begins March 31. The meeting is in person only, but most sessions are recorded and the full package includes on-demand access through 2030.

Abstracts are accepted through November 23, 2026, and early-bird pricing (a $200 saving) ends January 27, 2027. The On Demand-only package is listed at $525 for members and $685 for nonmembers; the in-person rates are shown only inside the registration system, and CME credit details and the 2027 schedule were not yet published.
